guard: a connection-changing op branches on supportsToolListAnnounce, never on a connector name; undeclared is refuse, not a no-op; the refusal names no connector
why: Issue #1004. The advertised tool list depends on the connection. Some hosts can announce
a change; some cannot. A consumer that special-cases today's names, or that treats an
undeclared flag as a silent no-op, is the defect wearing the fix's clothes.
N1 restores silent-downgrade: undeclared returns instead of throwing. It must redden the
N2 restores name-special-casing: the helper throws for a hardcoded announcer name even when
that connector declared the flag. The declared-true cell goes red.
N3 puts a shipped harness name into the refusal. The cell that requires the message contain
NO connector name at all must redden. That is the ruling's own cell.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite imports ../src, so the mutated source is the source it runs.
The command calls tsx directly so pnpm does not try to install in this worktree.

mutations.name: N1 undeclared becomes a silent no-op
mutations.expectRed: undeclared is refused (default-deny, not a no-op)
mutations.cell: undeclared is refused (default-deny, not a no-op)
mutations.note: The standing default-deny ruling: an undeclared capability must fail loud, never quietly become a no-op.

mutations.name: N2 the helper special-cases a name instead of the declaration
mutations.replace:
if ("name" in connector && connector.name === "smoke-announce-unknown") { throw new Error("this connector cannot announce a tool-list change, so a connection change is refused rather than leaving a stale advertised surface"); }
  if (connector.supportsToolListAnnounce === true) return;
mutations.note: Name-special-casing is the ruling's forbidden shape. Forcing a throw on the unknown announcer's name proves a consumer that branched on a string would break a connector the CLI has never heard of.

mutations.name: N3 the refusal names a shipped harness
mutations.find: "this connector cannot announce a tool-list change, so a connection change is refused rather than leaving a stale advertised surface",
mutations.replace: "claude connector cannot announce a tool-list change, so a connection change is refused rather than leaving a stale advertised surface",
mutations.expectRed: the refusal message contains no connector name at all
mutations.cell: the refusal message contains no connector name at all
mutations.note: David's ruling as a cell: the refusal must name no harness. Putting claude in the message is the favoritism the flag exists to forbid.
